title: Doctor
hint: Checks the saved SKILL.md and its folder. Nothing is sent to a model.
unsaved: Unsaved edits are checked after you save.
badgeTitle: Doctor: {summary}. Click to open the skill.

rule.unreadable: SKILL.md is missing, can't be read, or is too large to read.
rule.missing-description: The frontmatter has no `description`, so the model can't tell when to load this skill.
rule.invalid-id: Folder name "{id}" isn't a valid skill id: use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
rule.name-id-mismatch: Name "{name}" doesn't match the folder name "{id}", which the engines use as the id.
rule.unknown-frontmatter-key: Unknown frontmatter key "{key}": the engines may ignore it.
rule.description-too-short: The description is {chars} characters; under {min} gives the model too little to decide on.
rule.description-too-long: The description is {chars} characters; over {max} takes room in the skill list of every turn.
rule.description-no-trigger: The description says what the skill does but not when to use it (e.g. "Use when…").
rule.shadowed-id: A personal skill "{id}" in {engine}'s HOME folder is used instead of this one.
rule.body-empty: SKILL.md has no instructions after the frontmatter.
rule.body-too-large: SKILL.md is {kb} KB (over {max_kb} KB): it fills the context each time the skill loads.
rule.broken-link: Link to "{target}", but no such file is in the skill folder.
rule.link-outside-folder: Link to "{target}" points outside the skill folder, which isn't copied with the skill.
rule.oversized-asset: "{path}" is {kb} KB: large files make the skill slow to copy and share.
